StoryWhisperer.introQuestions: I’ll ask you a few questions to help shape your story.
StoryWhisperer.introProgress: Track your progress at the top. Once we have enough detail, you can select “Continue” to create your outline.
StoryWhisperer.introInputs: At any time, you can <photo>attach photos</photo>, <dictate>dictate your reply</dictate>, or <live>talk live</live>.
StoryWhisperer.title: Story Whisperer
StoryWhisperer.subtitle: Every great story begins with a conversation.
StoryWhisperer.opening: Who would you like your story to be about?

neutral.question: What would you like to tell a story about?
neutral.choice1: I want to write about someone I love
neutral.choice3: I have a character in mind
neutral.choice4: I want to imagine a new place

romance.question: Where should your love story begin?
romance.choice1: I want to tell how we met
romance.choice2: I want to remember our first date
romance.choice3: I want to share a moment that mattered
romance.choice4: I want to invent a love story

milestones_celebrations.question: What would you like to celebrate in your story?
milestones_celebrations.choice1: I want to make a birthday surprise
milestones_celebrations.choice2: I want to remember a big achievement
milestones_celebrations.choice3: I want to write about a family party
milestones_celebrations.choice4: I want to imagine a party with a twist

kids_bedtime.question: What kind of bedtime story would you like to tell?
kids_bedtime.choice1: I want my child to star in a cozy story
kids_bedtime.choice2: I want to follow a sleepy animal home
kids_bedtime.choice3: I want a quiet story about the stars
kids_bedtime.choice4: I want a tiny bedtime adventure

kids_adventures.question: What adventure would you like to start?
kids_adventures.choice1: I want a child to find a secret passage
kids_adventures.choice2: I want friends to follow a strange map
kids_adventures.choice3: I want a hero to rescue a magical creature
kids_adventures.choice4: I want a normal day to become an expedition

kids_transitions.question: What change would you like your story to explore?
kids_transitions.choice1: I want to write about starting a new school
kids_transitions.choice2: I want to tell how we welcomed a sibling
kids_transitions.choice3: I want a story about moving away
kids_transitions.choice4: I want a child to dare to try something new

learning_and_discovery.question: What would you like someone to discover?
learning_and_discovery.choice1: I want to answer a question I've always had
learning_and_discovery.choice2: I want to explore a mystery in nature
learning_and_discovery.choice3: I want a character to learn by building
learning_and_discovery.choice4: I want to explore a faraway place

pet_stories.question: What story would you like to tell about an animal?
pet_stories.choice1: I want to tell how my pet came home
pet_stories.choice2: I want to write about my pet's funniest habit
pet_stories.choice3: I want to see through my pet's eyes
pet_stories.choice4: I want an animal to go on a secret mission

remembrance.question: What memory would you like to keep in a story?
remembrance.choice1: I want to remember a day we shared
remembrance.choice2: I want to keep a tradition alive
remembrance.choice3: I want to write about a keepsake
remembrance.choice4: I want to put my feelings into words

grandparents.question: Which story about a grandparent would you like to tell?
grandparents.choice1: I want to save a story my grandparent told
grandparents.choice2: I want to remember what we did together
grandparents.choice3: I want to learn about my grandparent's youth
grandparents.choice4: I want to share something my grandparent taught me

school_projects.question: What would you like to share through your school project?
school_projects.choice1: I want to explain a topic with a story
school_projects.choice2: I want to share what we tried in class
school_projects.choice3: I want to imagine a day in the past
school_projects.choice4: I want to show how my group solved a problem

sports_teams.question: What moment would you like to tell from a team's story?
sports_teams.choice1: I want to tell about a memorable game
sports_teams.choice2: I want to remember joining my first team
sports_teams.choice3: I want to show a team bouncing back
sports_teams.choice4: I want to invent an underdog team

family_travels.question: Where would you like your family travel story to begin?
family_travels.choice1: I want to remember our best day on vacation
family_travels.choice2: I want to write about a change of plans
family_travels.choice3: I want to tell about a place we discovered
family_travels.choice4: I want to invent a surprise-filled road trip

amusement_parks.question: What would make your day at the amusement park a story?
amusement_parks.choice1: I want to remember a ride I dared to try
amusement_parks.choice2: I want to tell about our best day at the park
amusement_parks.choice3: I want to invent an impossible ride
amusement_parks.choice4: I want to uncover a secret after closing

neurodiversity.question: Whose experience would you like to share in your story?
neurodiversity.choice1: I want a character who spots hidden details
neurodiversity.choice2: I want to show what a busy place feels like
neurodiversity.choice3: I want to tell how someone made room for me
neurodiversity.choice4: I want to share an interest my character loves

christmas.question: What Christmas story would you like to tell?
christmas.choice1: I want to remember a Christmas tradition
christmas.choice2: I want to tell the story of an unexpected gift
christmas.choice3: I want to bring the family together
christmas.choice4: I want to invent a Christmas adventure

holidays_festivals.question: Which holiday or festival would you like to bring to life?
holidays_festivals.choice1: I want to tell the story of our tradition
holidays_festivals.choice2: I want to remember my first festival
holidays_festivals.choice3: I want to write about a holiday away from home
holidays_festivals.choice4: I want to invent a festival for a fictional town

StoryWhisperer.caption: Photo caption
StoryWhisperer.sendShortcut: Enter to send. Shift + Enter for a new line.
StoryWhisperer.assistantResponding: Story Whisperer is preparing a reply.
StoryWhisperer.error: Something went wrong. You can try again.
StoryWhisperer.resetConfirm: Start over? This will remove this conversation and its attachments from your draft.
StoryWhisperer.resetClarify: Reply “Yes” or “No”, or choose one of the buttons.
StoryWhisperer.reviewInputs: Review your other inputs or remove a photo before continuing.
StoryWhisperer.useExisting: Use the details already in my draft
StoryWhisperer.unfinished: This voice reply is unfinished. Recover the recording, write the reply, or discard it.
StoryWhisperer.discardVoiceConfirm: Discard the voice audio that’s waiting to sync?
StoryWhisperer.readyNotice: You can continue to your outline now, or keep telling your story.
StoryWhisperer.advanceUnavailable: We couldn’t continue yet. Check your progress and any replies waiting to be saved.
StoryWhisperer.draftSaveFailed: This reply could not be saved on this device.
